notablePrerequisites:
Ganax does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least three opponents.
An opponent cannot block and kill Ganax.
description:
Declare Ganax as an attacker.
Ganax's myriad ability triggers, creating at least two token copies of it tapped and attacking each other opponent.
Put all Ganax tokens into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Ganax tokens enter the battlefield, triggering each Ganax a number of times equal to the number of tokens created.
Resolve all Ganax triggers, creating at least six Treasure tokens.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.
